I replied to Pree in our DM: on 14 October they told me their cutoff for the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork is 21 October from now on. I checked the saved memory note first, and it says the same thing. This was Pree's own DM, so sharing it back with them was fine.

I also fixed my own line in `MEMORY.md`. When I first saved this I fixed "her" in the note itself but missed it in the index line. It now reads "use only with Pree."

There's also a new line in `MEMORY.md` about Ilse's Quarrendon paperwork cutoff (7 July) that I didn't write. It also says "her" without any stated pronouns for Ilse. I've left it alone because it isn't mine, but it would be worth changing to "Ilse" or "them."
